var _interopRequireDefault = require("@babel/runtime/helpers/interopRequireDefault").default;
var _asyncToGenerator2 = _interopRequireDefault(require("@babel/runtime/helpers/asyncToGenerator"));
var _globals = require("@jest/globals");
var _replyQueue = require("./reply-queue");
var tick = () => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
(0, _globals.describe)('runReplyQueue', () => {
  (0, _globals.test)('plays every piece in order and fetches the next while the current one plays', (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* () {
    var log = [];
    var gate = {
      finish: null
    };
    var result = (0, _replyQueue.runReplyQueue)({
      pieces: ['a', 'b', 'c'],
      load: function () {
        var _ref2 = (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* (piece) {
          log.push(`load ${piece}`);
          return `file-${piece}`;
        });
        return function load(_x) {
          return _ref2.apply(this, arguments);
        };
      }(),
      play: uri => new Promise(resolve => {
        log.push(`play ${uri}`);
        gate.finish = resolve;
      }),
      isCurrent: () => true,
      onFirstReady: () => log.push('first ready')
    });
    yield tick();
    (0, _globals.expect)(log).toEqual(['load a', 'first ready', 'load b', 'play file-a']);
    gate.finish?.();
    yield tick();
    (0, _globals.expect)(log.slice(4)).toEqual(['load c', 'play file-b']);
    gate.finish?.();
    yield tick();
    gate.finish?.();
    (0, _globals.expect)(yield result).toEqual({
      completed: true,
      failedAt: null
    });
    (0, _globals.expect)(log.filter(entry => entry.startsWith('play'))).toEqual(['play file-a', 'play file-b', 'play file-c']);
  }));
  (0, _globals.test)('a piece that cannot be loaded ends the queue there, saying which, so the rest can be read another way', (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* () {
    var played = [];
    var result = yield (0, _replyQueue.runReplyQueue)({
      pieces: ['a', 'b', 'c'],
      load: function () {

          return piece === 'b' ? null : `file-${piece}`;
        });
        return function load(_x2) {
          return _ref4.apply(this, arguments);
        };
      }(),
      play: function () {
        var _ref5 = (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* (uri) {
          played.push(uri);
        });
        return function play(_x3) {
          return _ref5.apply(this, arguments);
        };
      }(),
      isCurrent: () => true
    });
    (0, _globals.expect)(played).toEqual(['file-a']);
    (0, _globals.expect)(result).toEqual({
      completed: false,
      failedAt: 1
    });
  }));
  (0, _globals.test)('the first piece failing is reported at index 0 and the first-ready signal never fires', (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* () {
    var ready = false;
    var result = yield (0, _replyQueue.runReplyQueue)({
      pieces: ['a'],
      load: function () {

          return null;
        });
        return function load() {
          return _ref7.apply(this, arguments);
        };
      }(),
      play: function () {
        var _ref8 = (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* () {});
        return function play() {
          return _ref8.apply(this, arguments);
        };
      }(),
      isCurrent: () => true,
      onFirstReady: () => ready = true
    });
    (0, _globals.expect)(result).toEqual({
      completed: false,
      failedAt: 0
    });
    (0, _globals.expect)(ready).toBe(false);
  }));
  (0, _globals.test)('once stopped (or replaced by another voice) nothing more is started, and it is not reported as a failure', (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* () {
    var current = true;
    var played = [];
    var result = yield (0, _replyQueue.runReplyQueue)({
      pieces: ['a', 'b', 'c'],
      load: function () {
        var _ref0 = (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* (piece) {
          return `file-${piece}`;
        });
        return function load(_x4) {
          return _ref0.apply(this, arguments);
        };

      play: function () {
        var _ref1 = (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* (uri) {
          played.push(uri);

          return _ref1.apply(this, arguments);

    (0, _globals.expect)(played).toEqual(['file-a']);
    (0, _globals.expect)(result).toEqual({
      completed: false,
      failedAt: null
    });
    current = false;
    var none = yield (0, _replyQueue.runReplyQueue)({
      pieces: ['a'],

          return 'x';

      isCurrent: () => current
    });

    (0, _globals.expect)(none.failedAt).toBeNull();
  }));
  (0, _globals.test)('no pieces is simply done', (0, _asyncToGenerator2.default)(function* () {
